families.title: Charm vs Character
families.illusion: Attraction, charisma, gifting or public image is treated as proof of character.
transformationObjectives: value private character over public image
families.longTermLens: If the attractive behaviour continued for ten years, what would daily life actually look like?

families.title: Spirituality vs Discernment
families.illusion: Spiritual language is assumed to make a person or decision unquestionable.
transformationObjectives: join faith with wisdom and facts
families.longTermLens: What happens when spiritual language becomes the reason nobody is allowed to ask questions?

families.title: Leadership vs Control
families.illusion: Headship, submission or decisiveness is used to justify domination.
families.longTermLens: If disagreement is handled this way every month for ten years, who becomes smaller?

families.title: Chemistry vs Compatibility
families.illusion: Strong attraction is treated as evidence that major differences will solve themselves.
families.longTermLens: Would this difference still be workable after children, stress, illness and financial pressure?

families.title: Money vs Love
families.illusion: Financial sacrifice, generosity or rescue is treated as proof of love.
families.longTermLens: What would this money pattern do to the household after ten years?

families.title: Forgiveness vs Accountability
families.illusion: Forgiveness is used to erase consequences while repeated harm continues.
families.longTermLens: If nothing changes, is forgiveness becoming permission for the pattern to continue?

families.title: Family Honour vs Discernment
families.illusion: Family approval or rejection is treated as the final proof of whether a relationship is right.
families.longTermLens: Which family concerns would still matter if nobody were emotionally pressuring you?

families.title: Love vs Entitlement to Access
families.illusion: Closeness or commitment is treated as permission to control, pressure or access the other person.
families.longTermLens: What happens to freedom and safety if this behaviour becomes normal?

families.title: Purpose vs Self-Erasure
families.illusion: Marriage requires one person to disappear, abandon calling or carry an unfair burden.
families.longTermLens: Would this arrangement remain fair through career changes, children and seasons of pressure?

families.title: Faith vs False Either-Ors
families.illusion: Prayer and responsible care are presented as opposites.
families.longTermLens: When life is at stake, can both partners seek God and responsible qualified help without coercion?

families.title: Parenting Values vs Assumptions
families.illusion: Love is assumed to guarantee agreement about children.
families.longTermLens: How would this disagreement affect a child if it repeated for ten years?

families.title: Self-Deception vs Evidence
families.illusion: Attachment causes a person to explain away evidence because he or she desperately wants the relationship to work.
families.longTermLens: If your closest friend described this exact pattern, what would you tell him or her?
